data.description: Board request (chat DM @human:forrest, msg 119, 2026-08-30 17:50), verbatim: "also threads should just appear inline or in a large modal, and not in a sidebar. the sidebar is too narrow to read effectively". Design constraints: (1) AS-9 URL contract — ?t=<message-id> opens the thread rooted at that message and is the ONLY deep-link scheme into chat; the new inline/modal presentation must keep honoring t= links exactly (README "Deep links (AS-9)" section governs). (2) The roster/DM sidebar (AS-8) is a separate surface — replacing the THREAD panel must not disturb it. (3) The thread-scroll bug (AS-17) is being fixed at poll/render level independently; do not wait on it or duplicate it. Inline vs large modal is the planner-level choice — pick one, justify it in the plan.
data.title: Chat: threads render inline or in a large modal — retire the narrow thread sidebar

data.body: Bumped medium->high per board DM msg 160. Sequencing note for the planner: AS-23 (mobile-friendly layout, filed this tick from board DM msg 163) depends on the thread-presentation choice made here — a large modal is naturally full-screen on a phone; inline threads need their own narrow-viewport treatment. Decide with the 390px viewport in mind, and land AS-19 before AS-23.

Plan written (agent:cto-owen). Decision: LARGE MODAL, full-screen sheet at <=600px — not inline. Justified from our own data: #board thread replies average 1,458 chars (max ~3KB); in the 320px sidebar that is a ~75-line column, in an ~860px modal ~28 lines. Modal keeps its own scroll pane so AS-17's renderPreservingScroll applies unchanged; inline would re-entangle thread scroll with the channel pane across poll re-renders — the bug class AS-17 just fixed. AS-9 t= contract untouched: restoreFromUrl/openThread/closeThread semantics carry over verbatim, only the container changes. AS-23 recommendation: STAYS SEPARATE — AS-19 ships the modal's own narrow-viewport sheet (intrinsic to its CSS), AS-23 remains the sidebar-drawer/touch-target/keyboard pass. AS-25 unpainted: renderThread stays a pure consumer of state.lastData. Acceptance is honest about the harness gap: 8 hand-walk criteria (no browser harness exists) + suite green with url-state/scroll tests unmodified.

Implementation done (commits 8349061, d1737c7 on feat/AS-19-thread-rendering). Built exactly per plan: #thread-panel -> #thread-modal container swap, inner ids verbatim; dialog min(860px,92vw) x min(85vh,100%), 72ch body measure, full-screen sheet at <=600px (100dvh, no radius); role=dialog/aria-modal/aria-labelledby, focus -> #thread-input on open; close via x (existing closeThread), backdrop click, document-level Escape respecting defaultPrevented. Close-eligibility extracted to public/thread-modal.js (the plan's named candidate) with node:test coverage; registered in STATIC_FILES + served-over-HTTP test (AS-17 lesson). TESTED: suite 132/132 green in-container (was 126; +5 predicate tests, +1 served-page test); url-state.test.js and scroll.test.js UNMODIFIED and passing. Hand-walk evidence via throwaway container on :8399 (torn down): module graph all 200 with correct content-types incl. /thread-modal.js; served HTML carries modal skeleton + a11y attrs + all five inner ids, zero thread-panel remnants; served CSS carries 860px/85vh/72ch/600px-sheet rules, zero #thread-panel rules; deep-link URLs route to index.html. ONE DEVIATION (boring choice): #task-panel z-index 10 -> 40 so plain-click AS-n refs inside thread replies surface above the new backdrop (z 30) — plan listed task panel out of scope but the new overlay would have buried it. README needed no wording change (scanned; sidebar/panel phrasing is roster/task-panel only). Genuinely browser-only residual for QA/board: visual centering + reading feel on msg 113 (criterion 1-2), live Back/Forward popstate walk (4), poll scroll behavior with modal open (5), channel scroll position across open/close (6), sheet usability at 600px (7), roster behavior eyeball (8). Live server untouched; it runs the pre-AS-19 image until next compose build/restart.

QA REVIEW (agent:qa-priya, cold): PASS — 9/9 acceptance criteria at the strongest level available per criterion; no inline fixes needed; recommend done + merge after the board-walk items below are eyeballed (none are expected to fail; all automated/trace evidence is green).

METHOD: plan + implementer comments read; branch diff (git diff master...HEAD) read cold; suite run in-container myself: 132/132 green (was 126: +5 thread-modal predicate tests, +1 served-page test — matches claim). url-state.test.js and scroll.test.js byte-identical to master (git diff master...HEAD -- <both> is empty). Served-artifact checks via throwaway container on :8398 (asc-chat-test image, no mounts, torn down; live :8347 server untouched).

PER-CRITERION (level: container = served HTML/CSS assertions; trace = code-trace; unit = node:test):
1. PASS (container + trace): served HTML carries #thread-modal/#thread-dialog with role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, all five inner ids verbatim; zero 'thread-panel' occurrences in served HTML or CSS; dialog width min(860px,92vw). Visual centering = board-walk.
2. PASS (container): 72ch measure rule present ('#thread-messages .message .body { max-width: 72ch }'). Reading feel on msg 113 = board-walk.
3. PASS (unit + trace): restoreFromUrl/parse/serialize untouched by the diff; url-state.test.js unchanged and green; t-requires-c, m-ignored-with-t, dead-t-stripped-via-replaceState all flow through unchanged code; openThread(parsed.thread,{url:'none'}) now unhides #thread-modal — contract intact, presentation swapped. Fresh-paste and reload = board-walk.
4. PASS (unit + trace): Escape path traced — typeahead's keydown listener sits on #dm-search and calls preventDefault before the event bubbles to document; shouldCloseOnEscape refuses defaultPrevented events, refuses when modal hidden, accepts only key==='Escape' (5 unit tests). Backdrop: isBackdropClick(target===currentTarget) on the #thread-modal listener; dialog clicks bubble with inner targets and never qualify; #task-panel is a DOM sibling, so its clicks never reach the backdrop listener. All three closes route through closeThread() -> syncUrl('push'); Back -> popstate -> restoreFromUrl reopens via openThread(url:'none'); Forward (URL without t) closes via selectConversation's default keepThread:false. Double-open can't spam history (syncUrl equal-URL no-op guard). Live Back/Forward walk = board-walk.
5. PASS (unit + trace): poll -> selectConversation(keepThread:true, scroll:'preserve') -> renderThread() with forceBottom:false -> renderPreservingScroll on , which IS the modal pane (id verbatim inside #thread-dialog) — sticky-bottom semantics covered by unmodified scroll.test.js. Reply: thread composer wired to state.currentThreadRoot -> sendMessage -> selectConversation(keepThread:true, url:'none') — modal stays open, no history write. Live poll watch = board-walk.
6. PASS (trace): openThread/closeThread touch only #thread-modal.hidden + history; #messages scrollTop never read or written on open/close. Visual confirm = board-walk.
7. PASS (container + CSS read): <=600px sheet rules served (width:100%, 100dvh, radius 0); no fixed px widths in any new rule (860px only inside min() capped at 92vw); message bodies keep pre-wrap + break-word — no horizontal-scroll driver found. Real-device usability = board-walk.
8. PASS (trace): diff touches zero AS-8 sidebar HTML/CSS/JS. Eyeball = board-walk.
9. PASS (verified myself): node --test in-container 132/132; the two guarded suites unmodified.

DEVIATION JUDGMENT (task-panel z-index 10->40): SOUND, approved. Full z inventory: #dm-options 20 < backdrop 30 < task-panel 40. Without it, plain-click AS-n refs inside thread replies (bodyNode -> showTaskPanel) would open the panel invisibly beneath the backdrop. No other overlay fights it; task-panel close button stays reachable at z 40. The typeahead (z 20) sits under the backdrop while the modal is open — correct modal behavior, and the defaultPrevented Escape contract protects it regardless.

ATTACK FINDINGS (none blocking): (a) AS-6 parity on t= deep link to a hidden channel as non-member: fail-soft confirmed at trace level — resolveConversation resolves only against the viewer's visibility-filtered list, one neutral note for every cause, thread root resolved only against fetched messages, zero per-id network requests; openThread performs no fetch. No oracle. (b) Thread composer draft survives Escape-close/reopen (static textarea, hidden attr preserves value). (c) BACKLOG, not a blocker: text-selection drag that starts inside the dialog and releases on the backdrop dispatches click on the common ancestor (#thread-modal) and closes the modal mid-selection — matches the plan's stated click-target predicate exactly, so spec-compliant, but with 3KB prose selection is likely; v2 fix is a pointerdown-target check. Filing-worthy alongside AS-23.

BOARD-WALK RESIDUAL (browser-only, needs compose rebuild/restart to see AS-19 on :8347): visual centering + reading feel on board msg 113 (crit 1-2); fresh-paste + reload of /?c=board&t=113 (crit 3); live Escape/backdrop/x + Back/Forward walk (crit 4); poll scroll with modal open + scrolled up (crit 5); channel scroll across open/close (crit 6); 600px sheet usability (crit 7); roster eyeball (crit 8).

VERDICT: pass. No rework needed. Recommend orchestrator move to done and merge --no-ff per methodology; live server picks up AS-19 at next compose build/restart.

CORRECTION to the review comment above (shell quoting ate a substring): criterion 5 should read "renderPreservingScroll on the element selected by #thread-messages, which IS the modal pane (id verbatim inside #thread-dialog)". No change to any verdict.
